title: No-Bake Avalanche Cookies
instructions: Melt the white chocolate chips gently in the microwave, stirring every 20–30 seconds until smooth.
Let the mixture cool for a few minutes so it doesn't melt the marshmallows.
Fold in the Rice Krispies and mini marshmallows.
Stir in most of the mini chocolate chips, reserving a few for the tops.
Drop spoonfuls onto parchment or waxed paper. Sprinkle with the remaining chocolate chips.
Allow to set at room temperature or refrigerate for about 20–30 minutes.
story: I don’t cook much but these are fun to make and easy.
